facts.business: GTT Data Solutions Limited (formerly Cinerad Communications Limited) engages in fixed price contracts with customers, recognizing revenue over time using the input method based on efforts expended.

auditor.name: M/s. Mehta and Mehta, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matters: Revenue recognition for fixed price contracts using percentage of completion method; Assessment of going concern due to significant losses and current liabilities exceeding current assets by ₹1129.66 lakhs

key_risks: Revenue recognition complexity for fixed price contracts involving significant estimates of cost-to-completion, performance obligations, and transaction price
Going concern uncertainty due to significant losses and current liabilities exceeding current assets by ₹1129.66 lakhs
